dedup.horizon: all documents staged in this run
dedup.near: simhash64 over word 5-grams, 4 bands x 16 bits, hamming <= 3
dedup.order: global exact then global near, then split assignment, then per-source quota fill on train

shuffle.method: bucket = int(sha256(seed:doc_key)[:8],16) % buckets; buckets written in order, records in encounter order

source.name: cosmopedia-v2
source.provenance: Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct generated, seed data from FineWeb

sources.name: cosmopedia-v2
sources.provenance: Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct generated, seed data from FineWeb

split_policy.assignment: int(sha256(doc_key)[:8],16) % 1000; test < test_permille, validation < test+val, else train
